title: Docs mobile menu
summary: Open mobile Docs navigation with door tabs, current tree, theme row and moved chrome links.
compare: The open menu exposes Developers, Operate and Help doors.
The current door tree remains readable on phone.
Theme offers System, Dark and Light.

designReview.reviewer: pkey-ux-reviewer (rendered consumer, developer and brand lenses)
designReview.verdict: Consumer navigation review passed after the current tree and a visible drawer dismissal were restored.

findings.issue: The mobile drawer inherited the global hidden sidebar rule, so its current-door tree disappeared.
findings.resolution: Scoped the mobile sidebar override to the drawer so its tree remains visible.

findings.issue: The only Close menu control sat behind the visible drawer.
findings.resolution: Moved the close control into the drawer header.
